inputs.original_text: Phoenix city leaders are taking new steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement. The city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property. FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports.
inputs.modified_text: Phoenix city leaders voted Wednesday night to tighten restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property. Whatever justification they offer, this puts political agendas ahead of cooperation with those charged with enforcing the law. When local officials weaken the ability of federal authorities to do their jobs, public order and community safety are the ones at risk.
